activation: Root source/semantic review and separate Git payload/protocol freeze required. Not governed by or an activation of the old failed PAWS protocol.
observation_link: Q48/PR-11 in prior60-call advice wave; original candidate answer recommended E for gold WSC replacement and C for every non-gold replacement.
model_selection: Four prior declared hosted aliases, fixed before all candidate performance; immutable weights unavailable. No candidates added or removed based on observed scores.
source_scope: Official WSC source-train public data, curated subject-pronoun/titlecase-name slice; not held out from pretraining, not representative WSC. Analyst NLI labels are separate from source coreference annotations.

split.method: Random source-family ordering then greedy passage-count balancing; whole connected family assigned one role, ties randomized with fixed seed.
split.independence_limit: Distinct source-family clusters operationally reduce variant overlap; threshold clustering cannot prove semantic independence.

request_plan.model_blinding: Only opaque IDs, original premise and one replacement hypothesis plus common label definitions. No coreference labels, source/benchmark/role/variant/family IDs, evidence or judge facts transmitted.
request_plan.cost_limit: No account/USD/billing equivalence claim. Preserve provider usage and missing charges. Root assesses live pricing before freeze.

semantic_convention: Original unresolved passage transmitted. Official coreference gold supplies intended interpretation for source-only semantic review. Positive entailment and negative nonentailment separately validated, not inherited blindly. No official NLI gold claimed.

scoring.primary_unit: Passage pair: both gold and non-gold hypotheses classified correctly under the stated rule. Original answer called this role-swap accuracy, but these are paired WSC recasts, not literal swapped-argument minimal pairs.
scoring.literal_bad_pair: 1 iff gold prediction=entailment AND non-gold prediction=contradiction; otherwise0.
scoring.repaired_binary_pair: 1 iff gold prediction=entailment AND non-gold prediction in{neutral,contradiction}; otherwise0.
scoring.primary_score_distortion: Within candidate/cohort, repaired_binary_pair accuracy minus literal_bad_pair accuracy on the SAME predictions. The nonnegative arithmetic relation is expected by construction, not itself a novel causal discovery.
scoring.secondary_items: Individual classification accuracy under the same two rules; E/C macroF1 under literal labels with neutral treated as a wrong prediction; repaired E/nonE macroF1.
scoring.secondary_three_way: Only independently confident analyst negatives labeledN/C; positivesE. Report coverage and complete subset before scoring. Never exclude items after seeing candidate outputs or call this official NLI gold.

ranking_and_selection.fixed_comparisons: All6pairwise candidate comparisons, for both primary pair metric and secondary item metric, selection/confirmation/full descriptive cohorts. Full cohort ranking is descriptive, not independent decision consequence.
ranking_and_selection.primary_candidate_choice: Prospective raw-score selection abstraction: unique maximum primary paired score on selection cohort under each scoring rule. Winner sets for ties remain set-valued; do not choose an arbitrary tied candidate. This does not execute the complete Q48 significance-gated or alternative-macroF1 choice policy, so a changed raw winner is not proof that literal full advice would select it.
ranking_and_selection.primary_consequence: If both winner sets are unique, report repaired-selected minus literal-selected repaired_binary_pair accuracy on disjoint confirmation cohort. It may be positive, zero or negative; same selected model yields zero. No stopping/resampling to get reversal.
ranking_and_selection.ranking_reversal: Only strict opposite signs of the two non-tied candidate score differences, same fixed cohort. Null or tie is not a reversal.
ranking_and_selection.claim_limit: Scoring-rule comparison and declared raw-score selection abstraction conditional on fixed predictions/candidates and this validated source slice. No claim Q48 statistical gate was met or its full advice adopted. Repaired binary WSC recast measures directional entailment on this coreference-derived slice, not the full original argument-role target. Any external HANS target is a separately frozen supplement, not merged silently into this endpoint. Not real-user adoption, causal downstream harm, intrinsic WSC defect or general model ranking.

missing_data.full_candidate_primary: Requires valid complete predictions for ALL planned inputs for ALL four fixed candidates. If any missing/invalid capture, mark primary complete-candidate analysis incomplete. No dropping candidates, replacing responses, retries, or imputing semantic error.
missing_data.coupled_distortion_bounds: Primary pair repaired-minus-bad equals indicator(gold prediction=E AND non-gold prediction=N). It is fixed0 if observed gold is notE or observed non-gold is notN, fixed1 if both observed requirements hold, otherwise[0,1]. Individual-score distortion equals negativeN indicators divided by all ordered inputs. Do not subtract independently extremized score bounds as if predictions varied separately.
missing_data.additional_bounds: For each fixed cohort and score, missing/invalid predictions give conservative [0,1] contribution bounds at task or passage unit; if one pair member is known wrong the paired correctness upper bound is0, otherwise missing pair component yields[0,1]. Report score bounds for all four candidates. Declare robust ordering only if lower_A>upper_B or vice versa; overlap/ties remain indeterminate. Use bounded selection/winner sets rather than silently complete-case filtering.
missing_data.transport: A scorable capture requiresHTTP200, text/event-stream, terminal response.completed AND provider statuscompleted, nonempty finalassistanttext, no transport error/delta fallback/format deviation/malformed SSE JSON. Preserve event/status mismatches as operational incomplete.
missing_data.parser: Parse whole final assistant JSONobject, optionally one outer fencedJSONblock; all and only expected taskIDs once; labels casefolded entailment/contradiction/neutral. No fixing model outputs with a second call.

uncertainty.unit: Resample source-family clusters jointly across candidates within each cohort; carry all passages and both replacements in each chosen cluster.
uncertainty.interval: Two-sided95percentile, NumPy linear quantiles. Tiny/source-curated sample and cluster count limit interpretation; no population prevalence or significance claim.
uncertainty.implementation: NumPy default_rng(seed+offset), offsets selection=0/confirmation=1/all=2; multinomial counts forF source-family draws, passage-weighted means carrying all variants, item denominator2timespassages.
uncertainty.selection: Fix observed unique winners when bootstrapping confirmation effect; no bootstrap reselection. Report conditional selection uncertainty limitation.
uncertainty.dependence_limits: Family clustering is an operational approximation, not proof of independent schemas. Multiple families can share one request context; this bootstrap does not separately estimate cross-family batch or provider-level dependence. Intervals are descriptive conditional resampling, not calibrated population guarantees.

stopping: Attempt every frozen manifest row exactly once. Keep nulls, ties, invalid output and incomplete captures; no result-dependent new candidates, item changes or stopping.
human_review: pending; independent first agent semantic ratings are not external expert validation
